name: Operation Mandate
description:
Mandate authorizing the actor bound to authorizedActorChannel to invoke one
named operation through one exact effective channel, on behalf of the actor
bound to authorityHolderChannel.

It may be used on any target where the authority-holder actor participates in
the declared effective channel and all inherited lifecycle, actor, channel,
operation, document-version, and optional validation checks pass.

The inherited validation field examines the nested Operation Request.request
payload through its immutable request binding. It does not examine the target
document or Operation Request envelope.

Optional target.documentValidation examines only the frozen resolved target
root immediately before the candidate Timeline Entry. Its absence imposes no
target-document identity, type, or content restriction.

channel.description: Exact effective target channel authorized by this mandate.

operation.description: Single target operation authorized by this mandate.

documentValidation.description:
Optional deterministic target-document validation. Absence imposes no
document identity, type, or content restriction. When present, at least
one matcher is required and both configured matchers must pass.

document.description:
Optional structural Blue pattern matched candidate-first against the
frozen resolved target root immediately before the candidate entry.
Extra fields in the candidate are allowed; every omitted field is
unconstrained.

function.description:
Optional deterministic BEX validation program represented as a Blue
node. The host exposes $document as the exact resolved Mandate root and
targetDocument as the sole immutable candidate binding containing the
frozen resolved pre-entry target root.

It does not expose the operation request or other ambient bindings.
Request validation belongs to the inherited validation field.

Only Boolean true passes. False, null, undefined, a non-Boolean result,
compilation failure, execution failure, or resource-limit failure
rejects the candidate.
